steps.en: Add the package to a browser, Node or Deno project
steps.zh: 把包装进浏览器、Node 或 Deno 项目

steps.en: Load an existing PDF's bytes, or start a blank document
steps.zh: 读入已有 PDF 的字节，或新建一个空文档

steps.en: Parses the file in memory into pages, fonts and form fields you can edit
steps.zh: 在内存里把文件拆成可编辑的页面、字体和表单字段

steps.en: Draw text and images on pages, or fill named form fields
steps.zh: 在页面上写字、贴图，或按名字填表单字段

steps.en: Turns each call into PDF drawing instructions and field updates on the document
steps.zh: 把每次调用变成 PDF 绘制指令和字段更新，写进文档

steps.en: Serialize to bytes and download, upload or attach them
steps.zh: 序列化成字节，拿去下载、上传或当附件

value.en: Invoices, stamped pages and filled forms built in plain JS — no server-side PDF service or native binary
value.zh: 发票、加章页面、填好的表单都用纯 JS 生成，不需要服务端 PDF 服务或原生二进制
